watchme.trigger: each read of inference_calls — the probe counts post-era rows by outcome, so it rides the traffic that already exists rather than a clock, and it needs no live host of its own
watchme.enough: enough when at least one post-era row records a REFUSED ask AND the post-era answered rows are all still carrying real content and non-zero cost — the first half proves the write path exists at all and is not a shape nobody ever reaches, the second proves it did not corrupt the case it was grafted beside. A refusal-recording path that has never recorded a refusal is exactly as unproven as the guard this ticket descends from
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: the count of post-era refused rows by exception type, the count of post-era answered rows, and whether any refused row was ever served as a cache hit
watchme.consumer: whoever next debugs a failed drive — and the ticket that just closed, whose own watch had to be written around this absence
